notes.title: v1.0.11 - Sticker Customization & Box Storage Update
notes.content:
Hello, Mini Racer Enthusiasts 📦🚗✨  



We’re back with another feature update based on feedback and your growing need for more style, storage, and smoother customization!  As always, thank you for playing and sharing your thoughts every message and discussion helps shape the game.



And great news: Mini Racer Car Shop Simulator is joining the Steam Summer Sale with 25% off!  

If you’ve been watching the game or want to tell your friends, now’s the perfect time to grab it and join the fun.


New Features & Improvements

1. Sticker Customization System
Add personality to your cars with the new Sticker Customization feature!   You can now apply stickers to your vehicles to make them feel more unique and expressive. It’s a fun way to stand out, whether you're racing or just showing off your garage.

notes.title: v1.0.5-2025.22.2.2 - Customization Presets & QoL Improvements
notes.content:
Hello, Mini Racer Enthusiasts 🧰🏁

We’re back with another update focused on making car customization and progression even more streamlined.

Thank you again to everyone who’s been sharing ideas, bug reports, and feedback, these changes were made with your input in mind!

New Features & Improvements

• Car Customization Preset System  
You can now save a full set of installed spare parts as a preset. This makes it easier to apply the same build to other cars with just a few clicks. Whether you're testing performance combos or want to standardize your winning setup, presets are here to help. The preset menu appears in the bottom menu of the car customization.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45343939/7191c8114b1e9ddea42c26ed0b9c2ea1de6cc224.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45343939/ce0caccdb1b70b86d9be5e69b77c889f99d42b80.png
• Bulk Spare Part Unpacking  
Need more parts to sell your custom cars? You can now open all spare part packs in a box at once. This feature is available while the parts are still inside the original box.  
To open individual packs, just place them on a shelf and interact as usual. This streamlines inventory prep, especially when you're building multiple cars at once.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45343939/a9d1e3df6af2733c16d4e3522196714cf9bc3a8c.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45343939/4842710602f0843485815130f7b9eb36f4464f5e.png
Progression Update

• Objective Adjustment  
We’ve made a small but important balance change to one of the game objectives in Level 15:

Old: Win 10x Any 4-Star or Higher Events  
New: Win 10x Any 3-Star or Higher Events

This change is designed to smooth out the game difficulty and allow more flexibility in how you progress through event objectives based on the event calendar.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45343939/dadb3d64a7cec95852eaf53ca7122c761de8b2de.png
---

Thanks again for playing and supporting Mini Racer Car Shop Simulator. We’re continuing to listen and improve based on your experience.

If you’re enjoying the game, don’t forget to leave a positive review on our Steam page — your feedback helps more than you know!

Until next time, happy racing! 🚗🔧

notes.title: v1.0.1-2025.20.2.3 - Better Box Handling, Quality of Life Update & Bug Fix
notes.content:
Hello, everyone 🚗🏁

First of all, we want to say a huge thank you to everyone who has played Mini Racer Car Shop Simulator, left feedback, and joined the discussions on Steam. Your support and suggestions have been incredibly helpful in shaping this first update after launch.

We’ve been listening closely to your experiences, and today we’re rolling out several improvements and fixes based on your reports.

New Features & Improvements

• Improved Box Handling System  
We’ve updated the box carrying experience. The view now feels more comfortable when looking down, and the wobble effect has been removed, making box handling smoother and less distracting.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45343939/d1e025b0d0982dd065f0b45d776cf67e5661ef28.png
• Take Back Items from Shelves  
Made a placement mistake? You can now take back packs from shelves directly to the empty box in your hand, making store management and reorganization more flexible.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45343939/f373095467588b54ccf5077182144f6b4280b879.png

Spare parts box now open instantly without the extra unboxing animation, saving you time when need to open up spare part to customize your car.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45343939/8d0b87440ffaa5c61499a09db80b4515924daf4a.png
• Immersive Mode (HUD Toggle)  
You can now toggle Immersive Mode to hide all HUD elements, giving you a clean and distraction-free view. Perfect for focusing on the environment or capturing beautiful screenshots. Simply press the dedicated key to turn the HUD on or off at any time.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45343939/d7df0830b04ee931bfbd61e9dc15c9cb762a4062.png
Bug Fixes

• Fixed Customers Getting Stuck at Race Track  
We’ve fixed an issue where customers could get stuck at the race track until night, preventing store closure. This should now work as intended with smoother customer behavior.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45343939/fb8a3b71a9c14ebf1b986a7e50298b447c39f631.png

As always, thank you for your continued feedback and support. If you have feedback you can tell us more through the discussion and if you found any issue you can send through in-game Bug Report and tell us the problems. The in-game Bug Report Menu located in the Tab Menu on the Docs & Feedback.

If you’re enjoying the game, we’d really appreciate it if you could leave a positive review on our store page. Your support helps us improve and grow Mini Racer Car Shop Simulator for everyone.

notes.title: Cashier Employee, Custom Walls, and More
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

In this devlog, we’re sharing a round of Quality of Life improvements that aim to make your experience in Mini Racer Car Shop Simulator smoother, more enjoyable, and easier to manage — especially as your store grows.

These updates focus on helping you spend less time on repetitive tasks and more time doing what matters: building powerful cars and winning events.

🧾 Cashier Employee

Once you reach a certain chapter in your progression, you’ll unlock the Cashier Employee. This feature lets an NPC handle all transactions at the cashier desk for you.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45343939/4aa0bc5fe1f732034ae1a23082d7cf0d5f49d913.png
Now, instead of running back and forth between stocking and handling customers, you can focus fully on managing your car builds, upgrading parts, or preparing for upcoming events while your cashier keeps the store running.

Want to take over the cashier role yourself? No problem. You can easily switch roles by interacting with the employee at the counter:
- Interact with an active cashier to set them to Idle
- Interact again while idle to assign them back to the cashier role

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45343939/d96d6bf712cfa0fb369ebb2e03bdccb6364f66aa.png
This way, you can decide when you want to jump back in or let your employee handle it.

🎨 Wallpaper Decoration

Not satisfied with the default store walls? You can now personalize your shop by purchasing and applying custom wallpapers.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45343939/24aa40b55b3cf512af6fb2f685a784ca1b5e9771.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45343939/9b2cfdd2aaacd49f50cfcbc17077d46c3b8d7c75.png
There various design that you can buy to change the look of your store walls and helps reflect your personality so make your shop feel more like yours.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45343939/87cd81950fc7a1068f64dbd85b87431fe5cfce99.png
🏷️ Rename Your Store

You now have the option to change your store’s name at any time. Just walk outside and interact with the nameplate above your store entrance to edit it.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45343939/dc43da12c2a8ac26070d0a50651abfc9c6fbdcae.png
Whether you want something funny, serious, or themed, your shop name is now yours to define.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45343939/725c450725fab1361631fa5d3813bac0617ba252.png
🗑️ Indoor Trash Bin

Tired of running outside just to throw away empty boxes? We’ve added a Trash Bin inside the store, located near the spare parts inventory area.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45343939/ed5dd351b480f38a04980926069fe0f584d26b44.png
Now it’s faster and more efficient to keep your workspace clean and organized.

🪧 Floating Info for New Items

To help with orientation, we’ve added floating labels above new equipment or racks when you purchase them. This makes it much easier to spot where new furniture or displays have appeared and prevents confusion about where to look or what to move.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45343939/dbbbf68dd7b659521e9edc287773f2b30ec159c4.png
---

These are just some of the highlights in our ongoing effort to polish and improve the game. We’re constantly working to make the experience more intuitive and player-friendly, especially as the store expands and new systems are introduced.

Thanks as always for the support and feedback!

notes.title: Controller Support and Keybinding Options
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

In this devlog, we want to highlight a feature many players have been asking for that is game controller support.

Based on feedback from our previous games and demo sessions, we’ve heard loud and clear that many of you prefer using a controller while playing. That’s why in Mini Racer Car Shop Simulator, we’ve made sure to include controller support as a built in option from the start.

🎮 Your Choice to Use Controller or Keyboard

You can now play the game entirely with a gamepad controller, whether you're managing your shop, customizing your cars, or taking them out for a race. Movement, interaction, menus, and even other interaction are all supported.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45343939/ded6468d1a6c067a4faf9579ce3e50c000d6ebfc.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45343939/8abd2f9690cf47ff41d650798bb96bb60a5bca4c.png
Of course, keyboard and mouse are still fully supported as well and for both input types, we’ve added a layer of flexibility through custom keybinding.

🛠️ Customizable Keybinding for Both Controller and Keyboard

We understand that every player has their own comfort zone when it comes to controls. That’s why you can now remap buttons and keys to match your preferences. Whether you're using a controller or a keyboard, the input layout is fully configurable through the settings menu.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45343939/a5163be1fc7e1b751a25e71e0c31b5b8232cf7e0.png
This means:
- Adjust button layout for your gamepad to feel just right  
- Set keyboard key that suit your playstyle  
- Mix and match as needed to fit your setup

Our goal is simple, we want you to enjoy the game in the way that feels most comfortable to you. Whether you’re playing on a controller, using keyboard and mouse, or switching between both we’ve made it possible.

That's all for now thank you!

notes.title: Special Offers from the Salesperson
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

In this devlog, we’re introducing characters that brings great value to your shop, but only if you catch them at the right time the Salesperson.

Unlike the usual systems where you manage stock through standard menus, the Salesperson is an NPC who visits your shop from time to time, offering special deals you won’t want to miss. If you're looking to boost your store’s inventory or upgrade your space on a budget, this is your chance.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45343939/094d6c5ea957ea714517d27282e2ae496011bfbc.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45343939/87691f69bafad58bad78aca473507fbc0037ce54.png
🧰 What Does the Salesperson Offer?

The Salesperson doesn’t just bring one type of item and they can show up with different categories of goods, each offering strategic advantages:

1. Discounted Box Bundles (Cars & Spare Parts)  
You might be offered multi-item packs of car boxes or spare part boxes at a reduced price compared to regular store listings. It’s a great way to restock quickly, especially when you're preparing for upcoming events or just starting to scale up your inventory.

2. Discounted Sales Racks  
Occasionally, the Salesperson will offer specific display racks at a lower cost. This is especially helpful if you're expanding your shop and need more shelf space without spending too much of your funds.

3. Special Furniture Items  
Some of the rarest deals are supportive furniture pieces that give passive bonuses to your shop. These items may help attract more visitors, improve your shop’s atmosphere, or even increase the maximum selling price of your products. They're designed to help you optimize both aesthetics and store performance.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45343939/9ceba5855a5e647b5d922514888433cad654f7c0.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45343939/38b3ab51b5681fc0db3bab84b6c64e41a64e5f81.png

The Salesperson doesn’t stay long. They’ll appear randomly on certain days and leave at the end of the day, so if you see them, make sure to take a moment and interact. Once they’re gone, you’ll need to wait for their next visit to get another shot at those limited-time deals.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45343939/02d07ccf7167d114df01b3a7096f89ca486f5432.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45343939/79c8dbe1a07776110de76bfe0bf38852d96155c3.png

Tip: If you’re saving up for something or managing your stock carefully, it’s worth checking in whenever the Salesperson shows up. You never know what kind of deal you’ll get.

We added the Salesperson to bring more variety and unpredictability into the shop loop. Not every deal will be essential but some might be just what you need at the right moment. It also gives you another reason to keep checking in on your store’s routine and creates opportunities to get ahead through smart timing and good resource management.

That's all for now thank you!

notes.title: Get Ready to Race: Event System Overview
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

In this devlog, we’re excited to introduce a key part of the Mini Racer Car Shop Simulator experience that is racing events. These events are where your customized cars go head-to-head for rewards, bragging rights, and even prizes.

Whether you're tuning cars for speed, control, or smarter AI behavior, this is where all of it comes together.

🏁 Types of Events

There are three main types of events in the game:

Racing Event  
The classic race format. Finish first to earn cash rewards and sometimes bonus spare parts. It’s a great way to test the overall strength of your build.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45343939/4ffdc0a8cd195f48662de0a565d4dbe75bd9e07f.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45343939/3fba22543b04c446db9c36ad752fffae2f1dd275.png
Time Attack Event  
Here, you’re racing against the clock. The closer your time is to the target record, the more cash rewards you’ll receive. This event favors fast, efficient builds with strong acceleration.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45343939/0d62986cc1d08287332aed79d81de4e072bead90.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45343939/0f7f4a9d3f386bfc928b34c2a73c04cc2e4d8d39.png
Rival Battle Event  
A head-to-head challenge against a rival and their custom car. Win three times, and you’ll unlock their exclusive vehicle for yourself. It’s one of the most challenging but rewarding parts of the game.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45343939/33c07dfd19fc0afb476a846cfa9bdbcd63c3f185.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45343939/d61f03b1cd00c2f317dc9804f6b8d153527c44d2.png
🏆 Event Tier System

Each event has a Tier Level, which limits the maximum car rarity that can participate. For example, in a Tier 3 event, only cars with Rarity 3 or below are allowed.

This system is designed to keep things balanced and encourages you to maintain multiple builds, not just rely on your highest rarity cars.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45343939/9ba678ed42180db81904d16b695e0cf013ebd6ea.png
🗓️ Planning Your Race Week

Events are scheduled on specific in-game days. You can view these in the Calendar menu on your tablet and plan ahead for which events you want to join.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45343939/20bc104b328abc8d58cca33e9813b453da929945.png
To help with planning, there’s also a dedicated Event menu that summarizes upcoming events and their requirements, so you can easily track your goals and prepare accordingly.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45343939/148e06bdb50394c222d36e63e6810e78a7ef551b.png
This event system has been refined based on feedback from players who tried the demo and prologue. We want races to feel meaningful, strategic, and worth preparing for—whether you're here for the thrill of competition or the rewards that come with it.

Thank you for all of you who already tried or play the game on Demo version or Prologue, we’ve got more devlogs lined up, focusing on other features and content you’ll see in the full game.

notes.title: Optimization Update for Better and Smoother Play
notes.content:
Hi everyone,
In this devlog, we’re stepping away for a moment from gameplay content to talk about something just as important: performance optimization.

Thanks to all the feedback we received from players who tried the demo and prologue, we’ve been working hard to make the game run smoother, load faster, and feel better overall. These changes may not always be visible, but they make a real difference in how stable and comfortable the game feels.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45343939/111a7f2bcbc952a9ab517ee0ff1ea293ec618f58.png
What’s Been Optimized?
Here are some of the key areas we’ve focused on:

 Improved data loading – Game data is now loaded more efficiently, helping reduce wait times and lower memory usage, especially when transitioning between scenes.
 Better data handling – We’ve optimized how background systems process data, minimizing small stutters and improving flow during gameplay.
 UI performance improvements – Complex UI elements have been optimized so they no longer interfere with core systems, even when multiple menus are active.
 Algorithm refinements – Several internal processes have been reworked to use less processing power, making gameplay smoother and more responsive.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45343939/994d541c6d770699e63ae19ba3d84ea612663ea2.png
The game also includes a Settings menu that lets players adjust the game’s performance based on their hardware. These options have been available since the beginning, and include:

 Quality settings – Adjust overall visual quality
 Max FPS – Set the frame rate cap to suit your device
 Anti-aliasing – Toggle smoothing options for sharper visuals
 VSync – Sync frame rate with monitor refresh rate to reduce screen tearing


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45343939/e3057cc817687286bc51adfb3d73a25cfce0e67a.png
These settings are useful whether you’re playing on a high-end setup or something more modest. Our goal is to make sure the game feels good to play across as many systems as possible.

All these improvements are designed to support a smoother and more reliable experience, from customizing your cars to managing your shop to racing on track. We want every part of the game to run efficiently so you can focus on playing, not waiting or tweaking constantly.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45343939/59e47462cf6b1c05ef96589d6cfa47564d82904d.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45343939/5d286c8b27e17a175cbc723c664cb543d238b907.png
You can already feel some of these improvements in the latest Prologue version, and we’ll continue optimizing other parts of the game ahead of the full release.

Thanks for reading. We’ve got more devlogs lined up, focusing on other features and content you’ll see in the full game.

notes.title: Balancing Spare Parts: A Better Way to Custom Your Cars
notes.content:
Hey everyone,
In today’s devlog, we want to give info that you will be encounter in the the full version of Mini Racer Car Shop Simulator regarding the spare part rebalancing.

Spare parts are central to how you improve your cars in the game. Whether you're aiming for better speed, sharper handling, or smarter AI performance, every upgrade counts. In the full release, we’ve made some key changes to how these parts work and how you unlock them and creating a more balanced and rewarding experience overall.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45537470/6ea1a6ea64959b0be2560eeb3c369069b0929e15.png
Spare Parts & What They Do
Before we talk about the balancing changes, here’s a quick breakdown of how spare parts and performance stats work together:
Performance Stats:

 Top Speed – maximum speed your car can reach
 Acceleration – how fast your car gets to top speed
 Handling – stability and control, to make better speed in turns
 AI Level – how smart your car is at choosing lanes and paths during races

Spare Part Categories:

 Motor – increases Top Speed, perfect for long straights
 AI Engine – improves AI Level, helps your car make smarter decisions
 Suspension – boosts Handling, giving you better control in corners
 Turbo – raises Acceleration and Top Speed, ideal for fast recovery
 Rim & Tire – improves Handling, especially on technical tracks
 Chassis – enhances Acceleration, Handling, and Top Speed, offering balanced performance

Choosing the right combination of parts makes a huge difference, especially as races get more competitive later in the game.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45537470/6ee8a12397cbeecad5cf455d1f69e50bacc48761.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45537470/0eff72465045a98ef2cf4d91ab3c82aab925546f.png
What’s Changing in the Full Version?
We’ve rebalanced two major things:
[olist]
 The effects of each spare part, to make every upgrade more meaningful
 The unlock progression, so that parts become available gradually, encouraging better planning
[/olist]
Even with this structured progression, there are still chances to earn parts early. You might get a high quality part from a car box bonus, or win them by placing well in race events.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45537470/942680dee762e37928e24a1035226bb14f7788af.png
Custom Value and Selling Extras
There’s more good news, by adding spare parts to a car not only improves performance but it also increases the car’s selling price. If you enjoy customizing cars for resale, this is a great way to earn extra income. And if you ever find yourself with spare parts you don’t need? No worries, you can sell excess parts directly. It's a useful way to turn leftovers into cash and fund your next upgrade or restock.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45537470/53b30c26cd250de847ace9aaa4116976c824b10b.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45537470/b9384bd5aec7cc1addabc3a1561a2c26a0c1632a.png
With these balancing changes, we’re aiming to make gameplay feel more strategic, where your choices in upgrading and selling really matter.

That’s it for now. We’ve got more devlogs on the way covering more contents and feature you will encounter in the full version of the game.

notes.title: Leveling Up the Collection: New High-Rarity Cars
notes.content:
Hi everyone!
Welcome to the devlog for Mini Racer Car Shop Simulator.

In this post, we want to give you a quick look at some of the content you’ll encounter as you progress through the game—especially the new car models coming to the shop. These are higher rarity cars (Level 4 and 5), which means they offer better performance and have a more striking look compared to the early-game models.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45343939/45c01668f82e3ae20f5f5b8ee700f7dad6852f0d.png
These cars will start showing up later in your journey and can be sold to customers or kept in your collection for racing. They’re designed to stand out with a more powerful build and a more aggressive design style—perfect for players who enjoy tuning and racing at a higher level.

Customization: The Core of the Game
If you're new to the game: in Mini Racer Car Shop Simulator, every car that enters your collection can be customized using various spare parts. The goal is to improve the car’s stats so it performs better in test drives or actual races.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45343939/d0d8b03f214acf194765163995943b996e5776b7.png
Here’s a quick rundown of the main parts you can modify:

 Chassis – improves acceleration, handling, and top speed
 Tires & Rims – improve handling
 Suspension – make proper boost for handling
 Turbo & Motor – for acceleration and top speed
 AI Engine – helps your car drive smarter during races


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45343939/671fa1b6c5bf736b51cdbe56cab5385fbc5e3d67.png
Each of these parts can be mixed and matched to suit your strategy—whether you’re aiming for straight-line speed or better control around tight corners.

From Shop to Track
After customizing a car, you’ll have two choices:

 Test Drive it to see how it feels, or
 Join a competition and race for prize money

This loop of collecting, customizing, and racing is the heart of the game. And with the new high-rarity cars, there’s even more room to explore different builds and strategies.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45343939/256843b883bfda39b8094a4a8edd0c3d2a191627.png
That’s it for now. In upcoming devlogs, we’ll go deeper into more contents and feature you will encounter in the full version of the game.

notes.title: Update v2024.51.1.1 - Spare Part Installation Flexibility and More
notes.content:
Hi Mini Racer Car Lovers!! 🏎️🚗

Welcome to our first devlog! Based on our Steam dashboard report, there are now hundreds of players who have tried the game. We’ve also seen some YouTubers play the demo. Thank you for all your enthusiasm for Mini Racer Car Shop Simulator! 😀

Through the gameplay you've been doing, we've identified some improvements that need to be made. These improvements cover feature additions, feature enhancements, and bug fixes. Here are the first improvements we've made:

+ Ability to uninstall non-primary spare parts (Booster, AI Chip, Suspension)
+ Players are made invisible while racing (so the player's feet aren’t blocking the car)
+ Fixed the car placed in the bottom-left pitstop that couldn't be retrieved
+ Fixed customers getting stuck at the racing arena door when loading the game
+ Fixed the customer's body disappearing while waiting for payment during game load
+ Separated the Feedback menu into Feedback (Steam Hub) and Feedback (Form)
